title: Update
notes: Update flow now limits self-mutation to verified global installs and leaves other execution modes untouched.

title: Update On Start
notes: Startup update prompt is gated to true global npm and Bun installs only.

title: Update Install Scope
notes: CLI detects global npm and Bun install contexts and suppresses self-update for npx

title: Update Relaunch And Exit
notes: Accepted update prints relaunch instructions and exits.

title: Update No Means Continue
notes: Declining update continues normal app start.

title: Update Check Failure Does Not Block Start
notes: Version check timeout or failure falls through to normal startup.

title: Update On Command
notes: aio update explicitly checks the latest package version and applies supported global updates immediately.

title: Update Command Checks Latest Version
notes: aio update checks the latest published package version and reports when the current version is already up to date.

title: Update Command Applies Global Update
notes: aio update immediately runs the mapped global npm or Bun installer and prints manual guidance for non-persistent invocation contexts.

title: Release
notes: Release automation is tag-driven and publishes to npm through Trusted Publishing with GitHub OIDC.

title: Sync GitHub And Npm Release
notes: One tag-driven release flow now creates the GitHub Release and publishes to npm via Trusted Publishing.

title: Tag Drives Release
notes: Workflow runs from pushed version tags and validates tag and package version match.

title: Use Trusted Publishing
notes: Release workflow publishes with plain npm CLI under Trusted Publishing instead of a long-lived npm token.

title: Create GitHub Release
notes: Workflow creates or reuses the GitHub Release from the pushed tag before attempting npm publish.

title: Release Workflow File Is Release Yml
notes: Release workflow file is .github/workflows/release.yml.

title: GitHub Actions Uses Oidc
notes: Release workflow requests id-token write so GitHub Actions can publish through OIDC.

title: Use Trusted Publishing Toolchain
notes: Release workflow installs Node 24 and npm 11 before publish so npm trusted publishing can use GitHub OIDC and provenance-compatible package metadata.

title: Govern Release With Conventional Commits
notes: Conventional commits now drive roadmap commit boundaries

title: Commit Roadmap Units With Conventional Commits
notes: Repo-local commit skill now requires one conventional commit per completed requirement row and forbids grouping unrelated roadmap items.

title: Generate Changelog From Conventional History
notes: Release prep regenerates CHANGELOG.md from conventional commits before the release commit is tagged.

title: Prepare Semver Release From Conventional Commits
notes: Repo-local release skill and helper script now compute semver bumps from conventional commits since the latest tag and prepare the local release commit and tag.

title: Run Actions Only For Releases
notes: Branch-push changelog automation is removed so GitHub Actions only run from release tag pushes.

title: Distribution
notes: Package is published and runnable through package-manager entrypoints; CLI prints man style help for bare aio and help flags.

title: Run From Package Managers
notes: Current package supports manager-driven execution; equivalent help for aio aio help -h and --help.

title: Support Npx
notes: Published package supports npx execution.

title: Support Bunx
notes: Published package supports bunx execution.

title: Support Global Install
notes: Package exposes a bin suitable for global installation.

title: CLI shows man style help
notes: Bare aio and aio help -h and --help print the same man style help; no under construction placeholder.

title: Orchestration
notes: Declarative local orchestration coordinates AI roles

title: Project Orchestration Setup
notes: Project setup creates and updates .aio orchestration config without owning project knowledge.

title: Init Creates Aio Directory
notes: aio init creates the .aio directory structure with config

title: Setup Reconfigures Existing Project
notes: aio setup updates configuration when .aio already exists.

title: Aio Directory Stores Only Orchestration
notes: .aio contains orchestration files only; docs tasks specs and changelog stay outside.

title: Suggest Specs Roadmap Structure
notes: aio init can optionally suggest and scaffold this repo's specs directory and roadmap.csv project knowledge structure outside .aio.

title: Configure Roadmap Tracking File
notes: Init writes tracking file path to .aio config and passes it to provider requests as projectKnowledge.trackingFile.

title: Configure Execution Layer
notes: Roles and providers are configured separately so external AI tools remain replaceable.

title: Provider Wrappers Are Replaceable
notes: Providers wrap external AI CLIs and can be replaced or added without changing workflows.

title: Roles Bind Provider Context And Instructions
notes: Roles define provider model context instructions and output format.

title: Cursor Provider Calls Cursor Agent CLI
notes: Generated cursor.sh invokes cursor-agent in headless print mode with JSON output; requires CURSOR_API_KEY or normal CLI auth.

title: Run Workflows
notes: CLI can execute declarative workflows from .aio/workflows.

title: Run Default Workflow
notes: aio run loads and runs the default workflow.

title: Run Named Workflow
notes: aio run <workflow> loads and runs a named workflow.

title: Workflows Support Linear And Conditional Transitions
notes: Workflows support linear execution conditional transitions loops and final states.

title: Govern Long Running Execution
notes: Workflow runs expose usage controls notifications and live logs for long-running unattended projects.

title: Track Token And Context Budget
notes: Workflow runs track token usage context pressure and configured user caps so they can compact hand off warn or stop before saturation.

title: Limit Workflow Loops
notes: Workflow runs support global and loop-specific caps to prevent runaway cycles and subscription burn.

title: Notify Long Running Projects
notes: Long-running workflows can notify users from unattended environments such as VPS hosts when completion failure thresholds or attention events occur.

title: Stream Runtime Logs
notes: Workflow runs expose a real-time action and message feed with webhook and Discord mention support.

title: Resume After Provider Wait Window
notes: Workflow runs can detect provider time or credit windows notify the user wait for the resume window and relaunch the saved plan until completion.

title: Upgrade Aio Layout
notes: Backup re-init AI migration and remove backup for .aio template upgrades; migration provider is chosen at upgrade time.

title: Backup Existing Aio Folder
column12: aio upgrade renames .aio to a backup path before re-init.

title: Re-Initialize Layout In Place
notes: Fresh init recreates .aio from the current template after backup.

title: Migrate Customizations Via Ai Agent
notes: User picks which provider runs the AI migration from backup into the new .aio tree.

title: Remove Backup On Successful Migration
notes: Delete backup directory only after a successful migration; leave backup on failure with clear recovery instructions.
